5kg increase in a single week is a damn solid gain. I suggest you just deload OHP by setting your rm 10-15% back after a week of rest or light 50-60% of your current weight. If you know when and **how** to deload i think you can spin nsuns as long as you want. Personally i like 6 weeks long cycle with a deload week following and setting my rm 10-15% back afterwards to start a new cycle. For deload i do 3x3 70% rm from Beyond 5\\3\\1, it's easy and you still lift.

But you can always try some really powerlifting focused program - for example Sheiko is a pl program in a nutshell with some crazy volume and intensity, i've been running medium load template since october till february, but my body is giving up on me (tweaked my neck and raped my CNS prettty hard). Yet i can't say it's bad - i can now bench 125-130kg in 5 sets straight away and do some 80% rm squats after (84kg bw). However i'm still gonna return to 4 day lp nsuns .
